description: §61.2 — an `<endpoint>` opener is read whole by the markup attribute reader, whose attribute string is `"…"` only: a `'…'` value (`method='POST'`) is E-ATTR-001 at the `'`, and the `method=` it was meant for has no value the reader reads (E-ENDPOINT-METHOD-INVALID). It is never read as `method="POST"`.
provenance: S480 #2007 review (S239) item 1; §61.2 as amended by #1998 review r2 N1
rationale: §61.2: "an attribute string is `\"…\"` only (§4.18.3). A character that reader drops (a `'`, a backtick, …) … is `E-ATTR-001` at that character, never skipped"; "a `path=` / `method=` / `accepts=` / `cors=` written with no value, or with a value that is not its production's form, is that attribute's code."
